# Lumela 0.1.1

A small polish release.

## What's new

- **Icons in the toolbars.** Every button now has an icon, so tools are easier to find at a glance.
- **System font.** The interface uses your system's UI font (San Francisco on macOS, Segoe UI on Windows).
- **Linux: text recognition works out of the box with the `.deb`.** It now installs `tesseract-ocr` as a dependency. With the AppImage, install `tesseract-ocr` yourself.
- **Package managers.** Install with Homebrew (`brew trust tw4/tap && brew install --cask tw4/tap/lumela`) or Scoop. winget is on its way.

## Download

| Your system | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows 10 / 11** | `Lumela_0.1.1_x64-setup.exe` (recommended) or `Lumela_0.1.1_x64_en-US.msi` |
| **macOS** (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Lumela_0.1.1_universal.dmg` |
| **Linux** (x64): Ubuntu 24.04+, Debian 13+, Fedora 40+ or similar | `Lumela_0.1.1_amd64.AppImage` or `Lumela_0.1.1_amd64.deb` |

If you already have Lumela 0.1.0, it updates itself.

### First launch

Installers are not code-signed yet, so the operating system warns on first launch.

- **Windows:** *More info* → *Run anyway*.
- **macOS 15 and later:** open Lumela once and close the warning, then **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**. Installing with Homebrew skips this step.
